create_squad_data_source: create a SquadDataSource instance to load SQuAD JSON or TSV data files for reading comprehension
process_squad_json: process a SQuAD v2.0 JSON file yielding document-question-answer tuples with split support
process_squad_tsv: process a SQuAD TSV file yielding document-question-answer tuples with optional paraphrase handling
split_document: split a long document into overlapping pieces while re-aligning answer start indices
create_kd_data_source: create a SquadDataSourceForKD instance to load SQuAD data with soft labels and logits for knowledge distillation
